result.instructions: Tools for Collmex, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customer invoices are still open and how many days overdue are they?"; "Show all invoices to customer 12345 from the last quarter."; "How much stock is available for product A-100?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Collmex data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run collmex_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run collmex_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run collmex_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. collmex_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: collmex_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: Search Collmex customers (record CUSTOMER_GET): by customer number, free text (name, city, e-mail ...), postal code or country. Returns address, contact, bank (IBAN/BIC), VAT id, payment terms, agent and status fields. Inactive customers are left out unless asked for.

postcode_country.description: Postal code or country code to search by.

address_group.description: Only customers of this address group number.

company_no.description: Collmex company number (Verwaltung → Firma anzeigen und ändern). Default 1.

limit.description: Records returned, 1-500 (default 25; invoices and orders with many positions may need a smaller limit).

offset.description: Records to skip (use next_offset from the previous reply).

tools.name: collmex_list_vendors
tools.title: List vendors
tools.description: Search Collmex vendors/suppliers (record VENDOR_GET): by vendor number, free text, postal code or country. Returns address, contact, bank, VAT id, payment terms and expense account fields.

postcode_country.description: Postal code or country code to search by.

company_no.description: Collmex company number (Verwaltung → Firma anzeigen und ändern). Default 1.

limit.description: Records returned, 1-500 (default 25; invoices and orders with many positions may need a smaller limit).

offset.description: Records to skip (use next_offset from the previous reply).

tools.name: collmex_list_addresses
tools.title: List addresses
tools.description: Search the Collmex address book (record ADDRESS_GET): customers, vendors and address-book entries in one list, optionally with their contact persons. address_type: 0 all, 1 customers, 2 vendors, 3 address-book entries.

address_type.description: 0 or empty = all, 1 = customers, 2 = vendors, 3 = address-book entries.

postcode_country.description: Postal code or country code to search by.

address_group.description: Only addresses of this address group number.

company_no.description: Collmex company number (Verwaltung → Firma anzeigen und ändern). Default 1.

limit.description: Records returned, 1-500 (default 25; invoices and orders with many positions may need a smaller limit).

offset.description: Records to skip (use next_offset from the previous reply).

tools.name: collmex_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: Search Collmex products (record PRODUCT_GET): by product number, product group, free text (number, description, remark, GTIN, manufacturer) or price group. Returns description, unit, tax class, sales price, purchase data and stock settings.

product_group.description: Only products of this product group (and its subgroups).

price_group.description: Return the price of this price group (default: standard price group 0).

only_with_price.description: Only products that have a price.

company_no.description: Collmex company number (Verwaltung → Firma anzeigen und ändern). Default 1.

limit.description: Records returned, 1-500 (default 25; invoices and orders with many positions may need a smaller limit).

offset.description: Records to skip (use next_offset from the previous reply).

tools.name: collmex_get_available_stock
tools.title: Get available stock
tools.description: Currently available stock per product (record STOCK_AVAILABLE_GET): on-hand stock of the available stock types minus demand due today or earlier. A service product shows (NULL). Leave product_no empty for every product.

company_no.description: Collmex company number (Verwaltung → Firma anzeigen und ändern). Default 1.

limit.description: Records returned, 1-500 (default 25; invoices and orders with many positions may need a smaller limit).

offset.description: Records to skip (use next_offset from the previous reply).

tools.name: collmex_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: Search Collmex customer invoices and credit notes (record INVOICE_GET): by invoice number, customer, invoice date range, customer order or product. Each invoice has its header (customer address, dates, payment terms, status code: 0 new, 10 to be posted, 20 open, 30 dunned, 40 settled, 100 deleted) and its positions with quantities, prices and values. Reads only; no PDF/XML export.

customer_no.description: Only invoices of this customer number.

only_issued.description: Only invoices already printed or sent.

customer_order_no.description: Only invoices for this customer order number.

product_no.description: Only invoices with this product on at least one position.

company_no.description: Collmex company number (Verwaltung → Firma anzeigen und ändern). Default 1.

limit.description: Records returned, 1-500 (default 25; invoices and orders with many positions may need a smaller limit).

offset.description: Records to skip (use next_offset from the previous reply).

tools.name: collmex_list_sales_orders
tools.title: List sales orders
tools.description: Search Collmex customer orders (record SALES_ORDER_GET): by order number, customer, order date range or the customer's own order number. Each order has its header (customer address, dates, payment terms, status code: 0 new, 10 confirmed, 30 paid, 50 delivered, 90 invoiced, 100 done, 1000 cancelled) and its positions. Reads only; no PDF export.

customer_no.description: Only orders of this customer number.

company_no.description: Collmex company number (Verwaltung → Firma anzeigen und ändern). Default 1.

limit.description: Records returned, 1-500 (default 25; invoices and orders with many positions may need a smaller limit).

offset.description: Records to skip (use next_offset from the previous reply).

tools.name: collmex_list_payment_terms
tools.title: List payment terms
tools.description: The payment terms defined in Collmex (record TERMS_OF_PAYMENT_GET): number, description, payment method and discount periods. The number is what customers, vendors and invoices refer to as payment_terms.

limit.description: Records returned, 1-500 (default 25; invoices and orders with many positions may need a smaller limit).

offset.description: Records to skip (use next_offset from the previous reply).

tools.name: collmex_list_open_items
tools.title: List open items
tools.description: Open items (unpaid invoices) from the Collmex accounting (record OPEN_ITEMS_GET), for customers (receivables, default) or vendors (payables). Returns invoice number, document and due date, days overdue, dunning level, amount, paid and outstanding. Optionally as of a key date.

company_no.description: Collmex company number (Verwaltung → Firma anzeigen und ändern). Default 1.

limit.description: Records returned, 1-500 (default 25; invoices and orders with many positions may need a smaller limit).

offset.description: Records to skip (use next_offset from the previous reply).

tools.name: collmex_list_accounting_documents
tools.title: List accounting postings
tools.description: Accounting postings (record ACCDOC_GET), one row per posting position: posting number, date, text, account, debit/credit (0 debit, 1 credit), amount, customer/vendor, invoice number. Filter by fiscal year, account, cost centre, customer, vendor, invoice or document date range. Cancelled postings are excluded unless asked for.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year (for example 2026); default all years.

text.description: Free text in the posting text and memo (max 80 characters).

include_reversals.description: Also return cancelled and cancellation postings.

company_no.description: Collmex company number (Verwaltung → Firma anzeigen und ändern). Default 1.

limit.description: Records returned, 1-500 (default 25; invoices and orders with many positions may need a smaller limit).

offset.description: Records to skip (use next_offset from the previous reply).

tools.name: collmex_get_account_balances
tools.title: Get account balances
tools.description: Account balances from the Collmex accounting (record ACCBAL_GET) for a fiscal year: account number, name and balance. Filter by account, account group (1 other, 2 fixed assets, 3 bank/cash, 4 income, 5 expenses, 6 output VAT, 7 input VAT, 8 receivables, 9 payables, 10 depreciation, 11 provisions, 12 inventory, 13 private, 14 non-deductible expenses), cost centre or an up-to date. With a customer or vendor given, the date is ignored.

company_no.description: Collmex company number (Verwaltung → Firma anzeigen und ändern). Default 1.

limit.description: Records returned, 1-500 (default 25; invoices and orders with many positions may need a smaller limit).

offset.description: Records to skip (use next_offset from the previous reply).

tools.description: Collmex projects (record PROJECT_GET) with customer, budget, value of recorded activities, completion state and the project's rates (rate number, description, product, hourly or daily rate).

company_no.description: Collmex company number (Verwaltung → Firma anzeigen und ändern). Default 1.

tools.name: collmex_list_activities
tools.title: List project activities
tools.description: Recorded time-tracking activities (record ACTIVITIES_GET): project, employee, date, from/to times, breaks, description, and the invoice that billed it. Filter by project, employee (needs company), date range, only not-yet-billed or only invoice-relevant activities.

employee_no.description: Only activities of this employee number (company_no applies).

billable_only.description: Only activities of customer projects with an amount above zero.

company_no.description: Collmex company number (Verwaltung → Firma anzeigen und ändern). Default 1.

limit.description: Records returned, 1-500 (default 25; invoices and orders with many positions may need a smaller limit).

tools.name: collmex_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a NEW customer in Collmex (record CMXKND without a customer number, so Collmex assigns the next number; an existing customer is never overwritten). Each call creates another customer: check collmex_list_customers first to avoid duplicates. Nothing is sent to the customer. Give at least a company or a last name. Returns the new customer number.

payment_terms.description: Payment terms number (see collmex_list_payment_terms); empty = Collmex default.

company_no.description: Collmex company number (Verwaltung → Firma anzeigen und ändern). Default 1.

tools.name: collmex_create_address
tools.title: Create address-book entry
tools.description: WRITE: create a NEW entry in the Collmex address book (record CMXADR, address type 3, no address number so Collmex assigns one; existing addresses are never overwritten). Each call creates another entry: check collmex_list_addresses first to avoid duplicates. Nothing is sent to the person. Give at least a company or a last name. Returns the new address number.
